FAQ’s

1. How to Know if a Movie is Suitable for Children:

All movies are rated according to CBFC guidelines (U, U/A, A). You can find age-appropriate recommendations on the movie page on BookMyShow while booking tickets.

2. What Formats are Available for Movies?

You can enjoy movies in various formats including 2D, 3D, IMAX, 4DX, and ScreenX, depending on the cinema’s availability.

3. What Languages are Available for Movies?

Catch movies in your preferred language, such as Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and more. Use the language filter on BookMyShow to find your favourite movie in the desired language.

4. How Can I Watch a Movie Trailer Before Booking?

You can watch trailers for movies directly on the movie page on BookMyShow. Just click the thumbnail to view the trailer within the app.

5. How to Check Movie Reviews?

Check both critic and audience reviews on the movie page under the "Ratings & Reviews" section to get expert opinions and feedback from fellow movie-goers.

6. Can I Watch Regional or International Movies?

Yes, BookMyShow offers a wide range of regional and international movies. Use the language filter to find your preferred film.

7. How Can I Get Notified About Upcoming Movie Releases?

Stay updated on movie releases by clicking on ‘I’m Interested’ on the movie page. You'll receive notifications about the release date and exclusive alerts like advance bookings!

8. How to Find the Runtime of a Movie?

The runtime of a movie is listed on the movie page under the ‘Runtime’ section.

9. Can I Book Tickets for Special Formats Like Dolby Atmos or 4DX?

Yes, BookMyShow lets you book tickets for special formats like Dolby Atmos, 4DX, and IMAX. Check for these options under the cinema details while searching for showtimes or use the format filter.

10. How to See Movie Cast and Crew Details?

Check the Cast & Crew section on the movie page for detailed information about the movie’s cast and crew.

11. How to Book IMAX or 4DX Shows?

To book IMAX or 4DX shows, simply use the "Format" filter when booking your tickets.

12. Do 3D Movies Include Glasses?

Yes, most cinemas provide 3D glasses for viewing. A refundable deposit may sometimes be required.

13. How to Find Movies in My Favourite Genre?

Use the "Genre" filter on the booking page to easily find movies in genres like Action, Comedy, Drama, and more.

14. Are Horror Movies Available in 4DX?

Yes, many horror films are available in 4DX format to enhance the experience with thrilling effects!

15. Are There Movies Suitable for Kids?

Look for movies in the "Family" or "Animation" genres for kid-friendly options.

16. How to Find Superhero Movies?

Superhero movies are typically found under Action or Sci-Fi genres. Enjoy them in IMAX or 4DX for an immersive experience!

17. Where Can I Find the Latest Movie Ticket Offers, Discounts, and Coupons?

Visit the Offers page on BookMyShow for the latest cashback deals, promo codes, and special discounts. New deals are added regularly!
